faqsPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqsPage.metaDescription: Find answers to common questions about Pet Memo Shop pet memorial gifts, personalization, shipping, and NFC digital memorial pages.

0.q: Can I preview the design before production?
0.a: Yes. We send a design proof for your review and approval before any personalized item goes into production.

1.a: Production typically takes 3–5 business days after you approve your design proof.

2.q: Can I upload my pet's photo?
2.a: Yes. You can upload your pet's photo during the personalization step at checkout.

3.q: How does the NFC memorial page work?
3.a: The card contains an NFC chip. Tap it with a smartphone to open your pet's digital memorial page. A QR code backup is also included.

4.a: Yes. We ship worldwide with tracking provided for every order.

5.a: Customized products cannot be returned unless damaged or incorrect. Non-customized items may be returned within 30 days.

6.q: Is this suitable as a sympathy gift?
6.a: Absolutely. Our memorial keepsakes are thoughtfully designed as gentle sympathy gifts.

7.q: What payment methods do you accept?
7.a: We accept PayPal at checkout. PayPal also supports paying with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, and Google Pay where available in your region.
